label: Temperature limitation method
description: Specifies temperature limitation function of growth (0 = no limitation, 1 = CAEDYM style)

label: Growth temperature scaling
description: Arrhenius temperature scaling for growth function

label: Light model
description: Type of light response function (0 = no photoinhibition, 1 = photoinhibition)

label: Light half-saturation constant
description: Half saturation constant for light limitation of growth (used if lightModel=0)

label: Exudation fraction
description: Fraction of primary production lost to exudation

label: Respiration temperature scaling
description: Arrhenius temperature scaling factor for respiration

label: Respiration fraction
description: Fraction of metabolic loss that is true respiration

label: DOM fraction
description: Fraction of metabolic loss that is DOM

label: Salinity limitation at S_maxsp
description: Salinity limitation value at maximum salinity S_maxsp

label: Internal N dynamics
description: Simulate internal N (0 = assumed fixed C:N, 2 = dynamic C:N)

label: N uptake threshold
description: Nitrogen concentration below which uptake is 0

label: Constant internal N
description: Constant internal nitrogen concentration (used if simINDynamics = 0 or 1)

label: Minimum internal N
description: Minimum internal nitrogen concentration (used if simINDynamics = 2)

label: Maximum internal N
description: Maximum internal nitrogen concentration (used if simINDynamics = 2)

label: Max N uptake rate
description: Maximum nitrogen uptake rate (used if simINDynamics = 2)

label: N fixation growth reduction
description: Growth rate reduction under maximum nitrogen fixation (used if simNFixation > 0)

label: Internal P dynamics
description: Simulate internal phosphorus dynamics (0 = assumed fixed C:P, 2 = dynamic C:P)

label: P uptake threshold
description: Phosphorus concentration below which uptake is 0

label: Constant internal P
description: Constant internal phosphorus concentration (used if simIPDynamics = 0 or 1)

label: Minimum internal P
description: Minimum internal phosphorus concentration (used if simIPDynamics = 2)

label: Maximum internal P
description: Maximum internal phosphorus concentration (used if simIPDynamics = 2)

label: Max P uptake rate
description: Maximum phosphorus uptake rate (used if simIPDynamics = 2)

label: Si uptake threshold
description: Silica concentration below which uptake is 0

label: Density decrease rate coefficient
description: Minimum rate of density decrease with time

label: Downward motility N fraction
description: Fraction of maximum intracellular nitrogen where motility tends down towards nutrients

label: Upward motility N fraction
description: Fraction of maximum intracellular nitrogen where motility tends up towards light
